-- Panel.java --
package demo;
public class Panel extends BWebServlet {
  public void doPost(WebOp op) {
    BUser user = cx.getUser();
    user.checkInvoke(this, restart);
    post(restart, null, cx);
  }
  public void doGet(WebOp op) {
    if (!getPermissions(cx).hasOperatorInvoke()) throw new PermissionException("no");
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doPut(WebOp op) {
    cx.getUser().checkWrite(this, setpoint);
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void doDelete(WebOp op) {
    BPermissions p = cx.getUser().getPermissionsFor(this);
    if (!p.hasAdminInvoke()) return;
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  public void service(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) {
    if (!canInvoke(target)) return;
    post(a, b, cx);
  }
  @NiagaraRpc(permissions = "r")
  public BValue go(BValue arg) {
    cx.getUser().check(this, BPermissions.operatorInvoke);
    executor.execute(() -> post(a, arg, cx));
    return null;
  }
  public void doFlush(BValue arg, Context cx) {
    if (!cx.getUser().getPermissions().has(BPermissions.adminInvoke)) return;
    post(flush, arg, cx);
  }
}
